content.user_title: Build Convex Apps With Guided Skill Routing
content.value_statement: Convex projects span data, functions, realtime updates, storage, and security. This skill routes each task to the right focused Convex skill.
actual_capabilities: Routes Convex function work to the functions-focused skill.
Identifies schema, validation, realtime, storage, and migration skill paths.
Points advanced work toward agents, cron jobs, and component authoring skills.
Separates quick security checks from deeper security audit guidance.
Links users to primary and LLM-optimized Convex documentation.
limitations: It is an index skill and does not provide detailed implementation steps.
It depends on the referenced Convex skills being available.
It does not run, test, or validate Convex project code.
Documentation links require network access outside the skill file.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Convex Feature
use_cases.description: Select the right Convex skill sequence for functions, schema, realtime updates, and storage.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Data Model Changes
use_cases.description: Route schema updates, validators, migrations, and backfills to the most relevant guidance.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Security Review
use_cases.description: Choose between quick security checks and deeper audit guidance before release.

prompt_templates.title: Route My First Convex Task
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to Convex. Help me choose the right Convex skill for building [feature] and explain the first steps.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Core Backend Skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Map my feature into Convex functions, schema, and realtime needs. Recommend which Convex skills to use and in what order.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Data and Storage Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Convex workflow: [workflow]. Identify which skills cover schema changes, file storage, migrations, and HTTP actions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Advanced Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this Convex architecture for agents, cron jobs, components, security checks, and documentation gaps. Route each risk to the best skill.

output_examples.input: I need a chat app with live messages and file attachments.
output_examples.output: Recommended path: use convex-realtime for subscriptions, convex-file-storage for attachments, and convex-schema-validator for message records.

output_examples.input: Our schema changed and old records need cleanup.
output_examples.output: Start with convex-migrations, then use convex-schema-validator to verify the new model.

output_examples.input: I want a quick production readiness review.
output_examples.output: Use convex-security-check for a checklist, then convex-security-audit for deeper review.

best_practices: Start with best-practice guidance before selecting a narrow implementation skill.
Use schema guidance before writing functions that depend on new data shapes.
Run security guidance before shipping HTTP actions, agents, or scheduled jobs.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this index as complete implementation documentation.
Do not skip schema validation when adding mutations or migrations.
Do not use advanced agent or cron patterns without a security review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes Convex development questions to focused skills for functions, schemas, realtime updates, storage, security, and best practices.

faq.question: Does it write Convex code directly?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose the right specialized guidance before implementation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.

faq.question: When should I use the security skills?
faq.answer: Use them before releasing HTTP actions, agents, cron jobs, file storage, or permission-sensitive features.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: The routing content is local. The linked Convex documentation requires network access.

faq.question: Who is it for?
faq.answer: It is for developers and technical leads who need the correct Convex guidance quickly.
